source_summary: Tall hanging-scroll landscape with pale ink-wash mountains, a misty river valley, dense bamboo and trees, a riverside pavilion compound, travelers with a horse, a small stone bridge, and foreground rocks with pine-like branches. Seals, borders, and paper texture are excluded.

motifs.name: misty_left_mountain_ridges
motifs.description: Isolate the pale layered mountain silhouettes on the upper-left and middle-left: the low sloping ridge, the rounded peak at far left, and receding central hills fading into mist.
must_preserve: soft ink-wash gradations
blurred mist edges where ridges dissolve
faint contour lines along the left peak
subtle horizontal atmospheric bands
lightly textured rock faces without adding foreground trees

motifs.name: sheer_right_cliffs
motifs.description: Isolate the monumental vertical cliffs on the upper-right: the tall dark right wall, the central pillar-like cliff, adjoining ledges, and pale gaps of mist between rock masses.
must_preserve: vertical wash streaks
irregular jagged cliff silhouettes
faint fissure lines and darker cracks
soft tonal transitions inside the rock faces
mist-softened lower edges

motifs.name: central_bamboo_grove
motifs.description: Isolate the dense midground grove of bamboo-like trees rising from the bank, including clustered trunks, arching stems, feathery leaf masses, and the shaded understory around the roots.
must_preserve: fine individual bamboo leaves and needle-like strokes
overlapping dark and pale foliage clusters
slender leaning trunks and branch structure
ink density variation within the canopy
small grasses and low shrubs at the base

motifs.name: riverside_pavilion_compound
motifs.description: Isolate the right-side architectural compound set among trees: tiled roofs, ochre wall, open-front pavilion with columns and steps, visible standing figure at the doorway, and flowering shrubs immediately attached to the building.
must_preserve: precise roof geometry and layered eaves
curved roof tile linework
warm ochre wall color and brick pattern
vertical columns, door panels, and platform steps
small doorway figure gesture and robe folds
white blossom accents among surrounding shrubs

motifs.name: broad_misty_water_surface
motifs.description: Isolate the open river or lake surface across the lower-left and center, including the pale water plane, faint horizontal ripples, soft shoreline transitions, and misty reflections beneath the banks.
must_preserve: very faint horizontal ripple lines
transparent beige-gray wash of the water
soft mist bands crossing the surface
subtle bank edges and reflections
empty spatial quietness without adding figures or boats

motifs.name: traveling_party_with_horse
motifs.description: Isolate the small procession on the lower path: two attendants carrying items, a child or young attendant, luggage and bundle details, plus the robed rider on a pale horse with dark hat and saddle cloth.
must_preserve: delicate facial and hand linework
robe folds and pale color accents
red and tan bundle details
horse outline, bridle, legs, and pale wash
dark scholar hat and black saddle cloth
ground contact shadows and path placement

motifs.name: small_stone_arch_bridge
motifs.description: Isolate the low arched stone bridge at the lower-right edge, including railings, posts, curved parapet, steps, and the adjoining grassy bank where it meets the path.
must_preserve: arched parapet curve
rectangular posts and capstones
fine linear masonry edges
pale stone wash
small tufts of grass around the bridge foot
connection between bridge, path, and riverbank

motifs.name: foreground_rocks_and_twisted_pine
motifs.description: Isolate the foreground rocky bank spanning the bottom: angular boulders, dark twisted pine-like branches at left, low bamboo and shrubs, sloping rock slabs, and dark brushy vegetation along the base.
must_preserve: angular rock contour lines and dry-brush texture
dark cracked ink strokes on boulders
gnarled branching silhouette at lower left
small pine needles, bamboo leaves, and shrub dots
layered ground washes and grassy accents
strong diagonal rock forms that frame the scene

planning_prompt:
Analyze this Chinese landscape painting as a source for a motif bank.

Create exactly 8 reusable motifs. Return JSON only.

For each motif:
- Use a short snake_case name.
- Describe what should be isolated.
- Provide a normalized bbox as [x, y, width, height], where 0,0 is the top-left of the full image.
- Include all visible brushwork for that motif, but do not include unrelated neighboring motifs.
- Prefer motifs that can be recombined into a new coherent Chinese painting: mountains, hillsides, village clusters, pavilion groups, water/lotus surfaces, bridges, scholar figures, boats, clouds, rocks, shrubs, pines, willows, bamboo.
- Capture details that must be preserved: linework, wash texture, roof geometry, tree needles, rock texture, mist edges, and color accents.

Do not invent objects that are not visible in the source image.
Do not include calligraphy, seals, labels, borders, or paper texture as motifs unless explicitly requested.
